title: Trutek accepts replies with an invalid protocol checksum
summary: Identity, position and movement replies validate size/opcode/payload but never the fourth-byte additive checksum, unlike the repository simulator protocol. A corrupted frame with a plausible target slot can be accepted and report success. Validate checksum before consuming all reply types; add malformed-checksum regressions. Source-contract confirmation, no hardware claim. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
